clusters.name: Sunlit Anthems
clusters.description: The largest tribe. Energetic and danceable, mixed loud (-7.7 dB), low acousticness (0.25), high valence (0.67), tempo around 125 BPM. Every track is in a major key. Musically this is mainstream rock and pop: classic rock, album rock, soft rock, plus a large Latin and filmi contingent.
clusters.naming_justification: Named for the combination of high energy, high valence and major tonality - the 'bright' end of recorded music. The word 'Anthems' reflects the loud, full-band production profile rather than any genre label.

clusters.name: Instrumental Meditations
clusters.description: Defined almost entirely by instrumentalness (+2.64 SD, raw 0.81): tracks with essentially no sung vocal. Also the quietest tribe (-17.0 dB) and the most acoustic (0.81). Dominated by classical (36%) and jazz (28%): Bach, Mozart, Chopin, Beethoven, plus cool jazz and bebop.
clusters.naming_justification: Instrumentalness is the single dominant axis, and the low energy/low loudness profile gives the contemplative character. This is the cluster the plan anticipated under exactly this name.

clusters.name: Live on Stage
clusters.description: Separated on one axis: liveness +2.69 SD (raw 0.71), meaning audience presence detected in the recording. Otherwise energetic and loud, like the anthem tribes, and the longest tracks on average (4:39). Rock and pop live albums, long-form ragas and filmi performances.
clusters.naming_justification: A recording-context tribe rather than a sonic one: the defining feature is where the recording was made, not what was played. Named literally to avoid implying it is a genre.

clusters.name: Acoustic Storytellers
clusters.description: Low energy (0.30), high acousticness (0.75), quiet (-13.0 dB), low valence (0.39), but near-zero instrumentalness - a singer is present. Vocal jazz, adult standards, lounge, soul and ballads: Sinatra, Ella Fitzgerald, Billie Holiday, Lata Mangeshkar, alongside modern acoustic ballads.
clusters.naming_justification: The pairing of high acousticness with low instrumentalness means 'acoustic backing plus a voice'; the low valence gives the reflective, narrative character.

clusters.name: Spoken Word & Audio Drama
clusters.description: The cleanest tribe in the model: speechiness +4.04 SD (raw 0.87), short tracks (2:27), quiet and irregular in metre. 85% of its labelled tracks carry a spoken-word genre - German Hoerspiel series (Die drei ???, Benjamin Bluemchen, Bibi Blocksberg), Scandinavian barnsagor, audiobook chapters.
clusters.naming_justification: Highest internal silhouette (0.23) and highest genre purity (85%). Named for content type because the cluster is not music at all - it is serialised audio fiction that happens to be distributed on Spotify.

clusters.name: Midnight Anthems
clusters.tagline: The same drive, in minor keys
clusters.description: Sonically almost identical to Sunlit Anthems - same energy (0.68), loudness (-7.7 dB), danceability (0.63) and acousticness (0.26) - but every track is in a minor key. It skews noticeably more recent (median 2001 vs 1998) and carries more hip-hop (14% vs 9%) and electronic/dance (9% vs 7%), consistent with the industry-wide drift toward minor tonality in modern pop.
clusters.naming_justification: Named as the deliberate counterpart of cluster 0, because the split between them is tonal rather than sonic. The report documents this pair as an artifact of including the binary 'mode' feature in a Euclidean clustering.
